user.title: Solar Forecast — Location & Weather
user.description: Set your location and choose the weather forecast entity to use as the basis for solar production estimates.

data_description.latitude: Latitude of the solar panels (pre-filled from Home Assistant settings).
data_description.longitude: Longitude of the solar panels (pre-filled from Home Assistant settings).
data_description.elevation: Elevation above sea level in metres.
data_description.weather_entity: The weather integration entity that provides hourly forecasts (e.g. met.no).

panel.title: Add Panel Array {panel_index}
panel.description: Configure one roof section or panel array. You can add more arrays afterwards.

data_description.name: A descriptive name for this array, e.g. "South roof".
data_description.peak_power: Total rated peak power of this array in Watt-peak.
data_description.inclination: Tilt from horizontal: 0° = flat, 90° = vertical. Typically 30–45° in northern latitudes.
data_description.azimuth: Direction the panels face: 0° = North, 90° = East, 180° = South, 270° = West.

add_another.title: Add another panel array?
add_another.description: You can add more panel arrays to model different roof sections or orientations.

error.weather_entity_not_found: The selected weather entity was not found. Make sure it is loaded and try again.
error.panel_name_empty: Panel array name cannot be empty.
error.panel_name_duplicate: A panel array with this name already exists.

init.title: Solar Forecast Options
init.description: Manage panel arrays or change the weather entity.

remove_panel.title: Remove Panel Array
remove_panel.description: Select the panel array to remove.
